style: Minimal 2D side-view editorial illustrations. Warm ivory paper, terracotta capsule character, sage geometric platforms, charcoal outlines. One core mechanic per image; generous negative space; no scenery, text, or logos. Use jump-still.png as the style reference for subsequent mechanics.

jump.mode: built-in imagegen; GIF assembled from generated layers

prompts.still: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: Jump mechanic explanation for ez gamedev mechanics library, landscape 16:9. Create a deliberately SIMPLE, minimal editorial game-mechanic illustration. Exact composition: two low rectangular sage-green platforms on a warm ivory background, separated by a modest empty gap. Show one tiny original faceless terracotta capsule-like game character at the TOP of a single dotted parabolic jumping arc that starts on the left platform and ends on the right platform. Add a very faint desaturated ghost silhouette at takeoff and landing ONLY, to convey the same character's path through time. Clear takeoff, airborne apex, and safe landing; left-to-right movement. Dotted arc drawn charcoal with a small arrowhead near the right landing. Core idea is simply jumping upward and returning to ground under gravity. Flat 2D side view, simple rounded shapes, restrained hand-ink contours, extremely subtle paper grain. Palette: warm ivory #f3efe5, terracotta #b85032, muted sage #78836b, charcoal #35352e. Character has no clothing detail, facial features, or accessories, just small limbs that communicate the jump pose. Large generous negative space, uncluttered, quiet educational print illustration, crisp readable silhouettes that remain clear on a phone. NO scenery, sky, clouds, trees, castle, coins, hazards, HUD, frame, labels, words, typography, logos, glow, dramatic lighting, or watermark. Full landscape image with solid warm ivory background. This is the first of a coherent visual series; keep the reusable character and geometric platforms very simple.
prompts.background: Edit this Jump mechanic illustration into a clean animation BACKGROUND PLATE. Remove ONLY the solid terracotta character at the apex of the arc, seamlessly restore the ivory paper background and continue the dotted parabolic arc naturally through the area it occupied. Keep both platforms, both faint ghost figures, dotted arrow, colors, framing, and ALL exact positions unchanged. Same 16:9 canvas. No solid central character, no new objects, no text. This will be the stationary background under a separately animated character.
prompts.sprite: Extract ONLY the solid terracotta jumping character at the apex of this illustration as one isolated animation sprite on a fully TRANSPARENT background. Preserve the character's simple exact faceless rounded capsule-like design, raised arms and bent legs, terracotta fill, charcoal outline and gentle paper texture. Remove EVERYTHING else: no platforms, dotted line, ghost figures, ground, shadow or background. Entire isolated character fully visible, centered, tight square framing with about 10% padding. No redesign, no face, no accessories. The character must match the reference character.
